---
title: "Projects"
---

Projects are ordered by relevance to quantitative work. Each links to the source on GitHub.

## Financial dashboard

Interactive dashboard for market analysis built in Python and Streamlit. Real time technical analysis, algorithmic trading backtesting, risk metrics (Value at Risk, Beta) and price forecasting with Prophet.

Why it matters: it covers the full loop a quant cares about, signal, backtest, risk and forecast, in one working application.

[Source on GitHub](https://github.com/laurasalop03/financial-dashboard)

## Applied machine learning and deep learning

A portfolio of applied ML and DL work: predictive regression, computer vision autoencoders and optimized neural networks.

Why it matters: the same supervised and representation learning methods used here transfer directly to return prediction, feature construction and anomaly detection on financial data.

[Source on GitHub](https://github.com/laurasalop03/applied-ml-and-deep-learning)

## Combinatorial optimization and constraint satisfaction

Constraint satisfaction and optimization models built with MiniZinc, with symmetry breaking, search space pruning and performance benchmarking.

Why it matters: portfolio construction and allocation are constrained optimization problems, and this shows comfort with modelling and solving them rigorously.

[Source on GitHub](https://github.com/laurasalop03/combinatorial-optimization-csp)

## Advanced adversarial search

An intelligent agent that plays a deterministic game variant using advanced adversarial search techniques.

Why it matters: sequential decision making under an adversary, with search, pruning and evaluation functions, is close in spirit to strategy under uncertainty.

[Source on GitHub](https://github.com/laurasalop03/advanced-adversarial-search)

## Automated planning engine (PDDL)

A planning engine in the Fast Downward tradition, with A star search optimization, heuristic pruning and state space reduction.

Why it matters: heuristic search and state space reasoning are core algorithmic tools, and this demonstrates them end to end.

[Source on GitHub](https://github.com/laurasalop03/pddl-automated-planning-engine)

## Custom language compiler

A compiler for a custom language built in C with Flex and Bison: lexical and semantic analysis, AST generation and code translation.

Why it matters: low level rigor and careful systems work, useful when performance and correctness of numerical pipelines matter.

[Source on GitHub](https://github.com/laurasalop03/custom-language-compiler)
